title: DR.GAP: Mitigating Bias in Large Language Models using Gender-Aware Prompting with Demonstration and Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating accuracy gaps and population bias between masculine and feminine pronouns in coreference resolution tasks (WinoBias, WinoGender, GAP, BUG), measuring stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical associations in Question-Answering tasks (BBQ, StereoSet, UnQover), and assessing pronoun resolution bias in vision-language image captioning tasks (VisoGender).
